doc.brief: An interface for widgets with native scrolling ability.
doc.md:
An interface for widgets with native scrolling ability.

To implement this interface you should override the
[`Scrollable:hadjustment`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scrollable#property:hadjustment) and
[`Scrollable:vadjustment`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Scrollable#property:vadjustment) properties.

## Creating a scrollable widget

All scrollable widgets should do the following.

- When a parent widget sets the scrollable child widget’s adjustments,
  the widget should connect to the [`Adjustment::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:value-changed)
  signal. The child widget should then populate the adjustments’ properties
  as soon as possible, which usually means queueing an allocation right away
  and populating the properties in the [`Widget.size_allocate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#vfunc:size_allocate)
  implementation.

- Because its preferred size is the size for a fully expanded widget,
  the scrollable widget must be able to cope with underallocations.
  This means that it must accept any value passed to its
  [`Widget.size_allocate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#vfunc:size_allocate) implementation.

- When the parent allocates space to the scrollable child widget,
  the widget must ensure the adjustments’ property values are correct and up
  to date, for example using [`Adjustment.configure()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#method:configure).

- When any of the adjustments emits the [`Adjustment::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Adjustment#event:value-changed)
  signal, the scrollable widget should scroll its contents.

get_border.brief: Returns the size of a non-scrolling border around the outside of the scrollable.
get_border.md:
Returns the size of a non-scrolling border around the
outside of the scrollable.

An example for this would be treeview headers. GTK can use
this information to display overlaid graphics, like the
overshoot indication, at the right position.

get_hadjustment.md: Retrieves the `GtkAdjustment` used for horizontal scrolling.

get_vadjustment.brief: Retrieves the `GtkAdjustment` used for vertical scrolling.
get_vadjustment.md: Retrieves the `GtkAdjustment` used for vertical scrolling.

set_hadjustment.brief: Sets the horizontal adjustment of the `GtkScrollable`.
set_hadjustment.md: Sets the horizontal adjustment of the `GtkScrollable`.

set_hscroll_policy.md:
Sets the `GtkScrollablePolicy`.

The policy determines whether horizontal scrolling should start
below the minimum width or below the natural width.

set_vadjustment.brief: Sets the vertical adjustment of the `GtkScrollable`.
set_vadjustment.md: Sets the vertical adjustment of the `GtkScrollable`.

set_vscroll_policy.md:
Sets the `GtkScrollablePolicy`.

The policy determines whether vertical scrolling should start
below the minimum height or below the natural height.

hadjustment.md:
Horizontal `GtkAdjustment` of the scrollable widget.

This adjustment is shared between the scrollable widget and its parent.

hscroll-policy.brief: Determines when horizontal scrolling should start.
hscroll-policy.md: Determines when horizontal scrolling should start.

vadjustment.md:
Vertical `GtkAdjustment` of the scrollable widget.

This adjustment is shared between the scrollable widget and its parent.
